comments.author: Marco Reyes
comments.body: Trying openapi-typescript 7.x merge strategy vs our fork — fork is the one clearing required.

content.text: Trying openapi-typescript 7.x merge strategy vs our fork — fork is the one clearing required.

After running the OpenAPI codegen for SDK 2.1, TypeScript interfaces for create payloads mark project_key, summary, and issue_type as optional even though the API returns 400 without them. Call sites that relied on compile-time required checks now type-check with empty objects.

The generator maps all schema properties through a nullable-union helper that strips required[] when any property uses allOf wrappers. CreateIssueRequest is defined with allOf + required, and the helper drops the required list while merging.

Expectation: fields listed in the OpenAPI required array remain non-optional in the emitted .d.ts. Actual: every create body field is T | undefined, so strict clients ship incomplete requests that only fail at runtime.
